reviews.x: Understand that this bottle of Polish is tiny. Looks like a mini sample. I guess if you look at the ML you would know, but the image gives you no indication. Overall, a good tester bottle, but not realistic to have bottles this small

The quality is good with a color when warm being a light nude and when cooler it goes to a creamsicle orange and when cold it turns a pinkish red. In my experience the color changing aspect can be compromised by exposure to a lot of sunlight or harsh chemicals, but all in all it is a good value for something so unique.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bottle much smaller than expected, describing it as tiny or sample-sized.
The color-change effect is a highlight for some, who enjoy watching it shift between shades.
Several reviewers say the color change is too subtle or doesn't reach the darker shade shown in the pictures.
Some praise the formula for applying smoothly, curing quickly, and lasting for weeks without chipping.
Others report application problems, calling it too thin or runny and slow to dry.
